Choosing two disjoint distinguished components yields exact E Z_k and E Z_k Z_l and their ratio R_{n;k,l}. For feasible k+l≤n, d log R/dt=−(t+1)[(t+n)^{−1}+(t+m)^{−1}−(t+n−k)^{−1}−(t+n−l)^{−1}]<0 by strict convexity of reciprocal. The t→0+ ratio exceeds 1 by strict log-convexity of j^{j−1}/j!, t→∞ tends to a strictly subunit factorial ratio, proving exactly one zero. Infeasible pairs have product count zero. Crossed second derivative of H_t(x)=(x−1)log(x+t)−logGamma(x+1) and uniform trigamma expansion give n² H_{c sqrt(n)}''→3/2−c², so t*/sqrt(n)→sqrt(3/2) for fixed k<l. Independently checked n3 k1 l2 ratio equation gives t*=3/sqrt(2); inspected exact independent Prüfer enumeration verifier for n≤6.
